title: Minimax Rates for Aggregate Multipliers in a Three-Node Hidden-Network Panel
banked_reason: Sound slice-specific minimax and honest-length results, but the field-floor score gate capped the specialized three-node package at subfield (7.1 < 7.4); the remaining extensions are not bounded repairs.
gap_reasons: The matched minimax-risk and honest-length theorems are proved only for a fixed three-node Rademacher/Gaussian experiment, the positive noncancelled coefficient chart, known smoothness, and slices defined by the particular averaged contrast D.
The remaining D=0 and boundary branches are explicitly left open.
The projected intervals and upper-bound estimators are nonconstructive searches over the infinite-dimensional parameter class.
D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 7.1 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'field' is capped at 'subfield'.
proof_attempt_summary: The run established the six pooled polynomial identities, root-T global coefficient recovery, target-specific minimax and honest-length rates, reflection lower paths, and the complete power-law phase diagram on the stated positive noncancelled three-node experiment. Both typed panel reviewers passed the mathematics, but the field-tier review capped the specialized package at subfield. Reaching field would require new theory for a computable finite projection or a full semialgebraic classification of the open D=0, cancellation, and reflection-boundary branches.
tldr:
In a fixed legal three-node Rademacher/Gaussian panel experiment, six globally pooled polynomial moments learn the constant structural coefficients at root-\(T\) rate while a boundary-safe local smoother learns the target-time reduced form. The resulting sharp root-risk and honest-length orders are \(\min\{1,(\sqrt T\,\epsilon)^{-1}\}\) for the aggregate multiplier \(G\) and \(\max\{T^{-
u/(2
u+1)},\min\{1,(\sqrt T\,\epsilon)^{-1}\}\}\) for the individual spillover \(L_{\mathrm{spill}}\), even though the explicit reflection path gives both targets the same order-\(\epsilon\) local singularity. For \(\epsilon=T^{-a}\), the exact elbow is \(a_\star=1/(4
u+2)\): the orders differ below it, coincide at it, share the weak-global order for \(a_\star<a<1/2\), and are both inconsistent for \(a\ge1/2\). A single projected confidence construction remains honest through exact reflection; exhaustive exceptional-branch geometry remains open.
gap: Existing hidden-network identification excludes cancellation and the focal constant-diagonal symmetry, and existing weak-functional or modulus theories do not establish target-specific finite-distance rates for nonlinear resolvents over a nonconvex path image with remote exact fibers.
fill: Prove the six-moment reconstruction and its root-\(T\) estimator, a uniform finite-distance inverse, the branchwise cancellation/reflection classification, sharp target moduli and minimax risks, and reflection-honest projected intervals with matching expected-length orders.
